name: Journal of Clinical Informatics (custom profile)
scope: Applied machine learning in clinical settings, with an emphasis on deployment.
acceptance_bar: External validation on at least one held-out site, an error analysis that names the failure modes, and an explicit statement of what would be needed before clinical use. Retrospective-only work is publishable but must not use causal language.
review_form: Summary, major compulsory revisions, minor revisions, statistical review, data availability check, recommendation.
length_guidance: ~5000 words, structured abstract, up to 5 display items.
